clue.text: One very recent divorce

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
so means very, as in 'so kind'
late means recent, as in 'the late news'

explanation.surface: A newly separated person reflects on a very recent divorce.
explanation.walkthrough: 'divorce' is a verb here, meaning to cut off or separate.
explanation.definitionFit: To divorce something is to separate it from what it was joined to, which is to set it apart.

clue.text: Take advantage of 'obgoblin's stockings

parts.note: a hobgoblin is a mischievous sprite, an imp
stockings are hose, here said with the dropped h the clue's apostrophe shows, so just the last three letters

explanation.surface: A Cockney talks of taking advantage of a hobgoblin's stockings.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe in 'obgoblin shows the h is dropped, Cockney style; the same treatment turns the hose that are stockings into OSE.
explanation.definitionFit: To impose on someone is to take unfair advantage of their good nature.

clue.text: Deprived child in pub in African port

indicators.note: the pub's abbreviation sits inside the name of the port

parts.note: Oran is a port on the Algerian coast
PH is the map abbreviation for public house

explanation.surface: A neglected youngster is found drinking in a bar in a North African harbour town.
explanation.definitionFit: A child deprived of both parents by death is the standard sense of the word.

clue.text: An abstainer cut with stiletto when driving

parts.note: TT, teetotal, marks someone who abstains from alcohol
to hew is to cut with blows
a stiletto is a thin high heel on a shoe

explanation.surface: A teetotaller wounded with a stiletto knife at the wheel of a car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stiletto' suggests a dagger, but here it is the shoe heel.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone at the wheel is steering, so the phrase is an idiom for being the driver.

clue.text: Empty-headed dog welcomed on the golf course

indicators.note: with its head made empty, the dog's name loses its first letter

parts.note: a beagle is a hound breed

explanation.surface: A dim-witted dog is greeted warmly on the golf links.
explanation.definitionFit: An eagle is a score two under par on a hole, a result any golfer is glad to see.

clue.text: The country's getting a long examination

parts.note: Peru's: the South American country with a possessive s
L is the abbreviation for long, as in clothing sizes

explanation.surface: A nation faces a lengthy inspection.
explanation.definitionFit: A perusal is a careful reading or examination of something.

clue.text: Confine crowd without ticket to see star

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the confine-and-crowd pair goes around the ticket

parts.note: to pen is to confine
to ram is to crowd or cram in
a tag is a label or ticket

explanation.surface: Fans without tickets are penned in to watch a celebrity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' seems to mean lacking a ticket; here it has its old sense of outside.
explanation.definitionFit: A pentagram is a five-pointed star figure.

clue.text: King inclined to be enthralled

parts.note: R stands for Rex, Latin for king
apt means inclined or likely to

explanation.surface: A monarch is disposed to be captivated.
explanation.definitionFit: Rapt means wholly absorbed or spellbound.

clue.text: Small knife I bought initially for cut of meat

parts.note: a parer is a small knife for peeling

indicators.note: initially calls for just the opening letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A shopper buys a little knife to trim a joint.
explanation.definitionFit: A spare rib is a cut of pork from the ribs with little meat left on.

clue.text: Model kneels — is drunk

indicators.note: drunk suggests the letters reel about into a new order

explanation.surface: A model, the worse for drink, is down on her knees.
explanation.definitionFit: A likeness is a model or portrait that resembles its subject.

clue.text: Winger has relationship in the Gulf

indicators.note: the Greek letter sits inside the word for a gulf

parts.note: a pit is a deep gulf or chasm
pi is the ratio, a fixed relationship, of a circle's circumference to its diameter

explanation.surface: A footballer on the wing is having an affair in the Persian Gulf.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Winger' suggests a footballer; it is anything with wings, here a bird. The Greek letter goes in after the first two letters of the gulf.
explanation.definitionFit: A pipit is a small songbird, and so a creature with wings.

clue.text: Penny follows group to drooping access way

indicators.note: the coin's letter comes after the group, as follows indicates

parts.note: a gang is a group
lank means limp or drooping

explanation.surface: A coin follows a crowd to a sagging entrance.
explanation.definitionFit: A gangplank is the board used to walk onto or off a ship.

clue.text: Meat Cassie cooked for pet

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters have been worked over into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A woman named Cassie prepares meat for an animal.
explanation.definitionFit: The Siamese cat is a popular breed of domestic pet.

clue.text: Workers keeping one close

indicators.note: the workers hold the letter for one inside them

parts.note: men are workers, as in a firm's staff
the indefinite article stands for a single one

explanation.surface: The workforce keeps one nearby.
explanation.walkthrough: 'close' looks like near, but it is close-fisted.
explanation.definitionFit: A close person is tight with money, which is stingy.

clue.text: Crook approaches diagonally

parts.note: a crook is a bend or angle, a corner
ways are approaches or routes

explanation.surface: A villain approaches at a slant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crook' suggests a criminal; it means a bend.
explanation.definitionFit: Cornerways means across from corner to corner, at a slant.

clue.text: Insist choir deployed staginess

indicators.note: deployed suggests the letters are spread out and rearranged

explanation.surface: A demand that the choir be deployed shows theatrical exaggeration.
explanation.definitionFit: Histrionics are overly dramatic behaviour, a theatrical staginess.

clue.text: Pitch where drinks are taken through a straw

indicators.note: the drinks go inside the straw, like liquid sucked up through it

parts.note: a stalk is a straw, the dried stem of a cereal plant
ales are beers

explanation.surface: A bar where people sip their drinks through straws.
explanation.definitionFit: A sales pitch is persuasive talk designed to sell something.

clue.text: A price for facilitation

parts.note: the betting, in racing, is the odds or price offered on a horse

explanation.surface: Paying a fee to make something easier.
explanation.definitionFit: Abetting is helping or encouraging an act, making it easier to carry out.

clue.text: Is in bad sitcom showing resignation

indicators.note: the two letters are placed inside the rearranged comedy
bad suggests the sitcom is botched into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Appearing in a poor TV comedy shows acceptance of one's lot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' turns the comedy into STOICM, and the two letters of 'Is' go in near its end.
explanation.definitionFit: Stoicism is patient endurance of hardship, a resigned acceptance.

clue.text: Drink bottle miner smashed

indicators.note: smashed suggests the letters are broken and put back together differently

explanation.surface: A coal miner breaks a bottle over something.
explanation.definitionFit: Bitter lemon is a fizzy soft drink flavoured with lemon and quinine.

clue.text: Girl is out of the ordinary

definitions.meaning: the Ordinary of the Mass is its fixed parts

explanation.walkthrough: 'out of the ordinary' seems to mean unusual; it means taken from the Ordinary of the Mass.
explanation.definitionFit: Gloria is both a woman's name and the hymn of praise in the fixed part of the Mass.

clue.text: Bird is keen to go up it

indicators.note: in a down entry, going up reads the word from bottom to top

parts.note: to keen is to wail or weep

explanation.surface: A bird is eager to fly up.
explanation.definitionFit: Peewit is another name for the lapwing, a plover.

clue.text: Tory leader has pain in bum

indicators.note: leader asks for the first letter of the party word

parts.note: an ail is a pain or trouble

explanation.surface: The Conservative chief is a real pain in the backside.
explanation.definitionFit: Tail is slang for the buttocks, as bum is.

clue.text: Footwear for English banker wearing suit

indicators.note: the suit is worn around the banker, so the stream goes inside

parts.note: spades is a suit of cards
a banker is a thing with banks, a river; a rill is a small stream

explanation.surface: Shoes suited to an English financier in a business suit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'banker' suggests a financier; in crosswords it is a river.
explanation.definitionFit: An espadrille is a light canvas shoe with a rope sole.

clue.text: Help when ready

parts.note: as means when, as in 'as he left'
set means ready, as in 'ready, steady, go'

explanation.surface: Assistance arrives as soon as it is prepared.
explanation.definitionFit: An asset is a useful resource, something that helps.

clue.text: Fruit turning up in Brazil, Guyana etc

indicators.note: in a down entry, turning up reads the letters bottom to top
the letters lie inside the run of country names

explanation.surface: Fruit appears in South American countries.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' marks ILGU, from brazIL GUyana, which 'turning up' turns round.
explanation.definitionFit: The ugli is a Jamaican citrus fruit, a cross of grapefruit and tangerine.

clue.text: I inform against woman, thus clearing agent

parts.note: to sing is slang for informing on someone
a lass is a girl or woman

explanation.surface: Someone betrays a woman to make a chemical that clears liquid.
explanation.definitionFit: Isinglass is a gelatin from fish used to clear beer and wine.

clue.text: Quarrel in Arab street

parts.note: Ar is an abbreviation for Arabic
a row is a street of houses

explanation.surface: An argument in an Arab street.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Quarrel' suggests an argument; it is a crossbow bolt.
explanation.definitionFit: A quarrel is a short heavy arrow shot from a crossbow.

clue.text: Grandmaster containing one boy's stratagem

indicators.note: the chess title holds the numeral inside it

parts.note: GM is the abbreviation for chess grandmaster
one is the Roman numeral I
Mick is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A chess grandmaster uses a youngster's ploy.
explanation.definitionFit: A gimmick is a trick or device to win attention or advantage.

clue.text: Sectarian law set back diplomacy

indicators.note: back says the letters of set run in reverse

parts.note: tact is diplomacy

explanation.surface: A religious law sets back diplomatic relations.
explanation.definitionFit: The Test Act barred non-Anglicans from public office in England, a law dividing faiths.
